tracesTo: UserFlow: Weekly Member Engagement, Feed Interaction, Pick'ems & History Browsing

stories.title: View Most Recent Published Power Rankings
stories.goal: see the latest power rankings when I visit the rankings page
stories.benefit: I can quickly check the current team standings without having to navigate through week selectors
acceptanceCriteria: Page defaults to most recent week with published power rankings on initial load
System displays team rankings in table format with rank numbers (1, 2, 3...)
Each ranking row shows team name, logo, and commissioner commentary
If no rankings published for current season, system displays message indicating no rankings available
Page loads rankings data efficiently without unnecessary API calls

stories.title: Select Season to View Rankings
stories.goal: choose which season's power rankings I want to view
stories.benefit: I can review historical rankings from previous seasons and compare across years
acceptanceCriteria: Season selector dropdown displays all seasons with published power rankings
Current season is selected by default
Selecting a different season updates the week selector to show available weeks for that season
Selecting a season loads the most recent published week for that season
Dynasty leagues show continuous season history, redraft leagues show independent seasons

stories.title: Navigate Between Weekly Rankings
stories.goal: browse through different weeks of power rankings within a season
stories.benefit: I can see how rankings evolved throughout the season and find specific weeks of interest
acceptanceCriteria: Week selector dropdown shows all weeks with published rankings for selected season
Only weeks with published rankings are selectable in the dropdown
Selecting a week loads and displays that week's rankings table
System indicates current NFL week and most recent published week
Week selector shows week labels (Week 1, Week 2, etc.) with playoff weeks clearly marked

stories.title: Display Rankings Table with Team Details
stories.goal: see a clear table showing all team rankings with relevant details
stories.benefit: I can easily scan the rankings and understand each team's position and commentary
acceptanceCriteria: Table displays rank number, team logo, team name, and commissioner commentary in columns
Teams are ordered by rank from 1 (best) to N (worst)
Commissioner commentary is displayed in full or with expand/collapse for long text
Team logos render properly with fallback to team initials if logo unavailable
Table is responsive and adapts to mobile screen sizes

stories.title: Handle Weeks with No Published Rankings
stories.goal: understand when rankings are not available for a selected week
stories.benefit: I know whether rankings haven't been published yet or were skipped by the commissioner
acceptanceCriteria: If commissioner skipped rankings for a week, system displays message indicating rankings not available for that week
If commissioner hasn't published yet for current week, system displays message indicating rankings pending publication
System provides clear distinction between unpublished (draft) and skipped rankings
User can easily navigate to previous or next available week with published rankings
Message includes expected timeline if rankings are typically published on specific day

stories.title: View Commissioner Commentary for Each Team
stories.goal: read detailed commentary about why each team is ranked at their position
stories.benefit: I understand the reasoning behind rankings and get insights into team performance
acceptanceCriteria: Commentary text is clearly associated with each team's ranking row
Long commentary is readable without excessive scrolling (with expand/collapse if needed)
Commentary supports basic formatting (line breaks, emphasis) if provided by commissioner
If no commentary provided for a team, system displays a placeholder or leaves field empty
Commentary is searchable within the page for finding specific keywords or references
